Headline: #90 Harlem Temporary Southbound Reroute near Harlem Green Line
ShortDescription: Southbound 90 Harlem buses are temporarily rerouted due to street blockage near Harlem Green Line.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Southbound #90 Harlem buses are temporarily rerouted via Harlem, Lake, Forest Avenue, South Boulevard, and over regular route, due to street blockage near Harlem Green Line.

Northbound buses are not affected.

Allow extra travel time.
